reference_fields: Fruit Quality Characteristics of Three New Peach and Nectarine Varieties: Brigantine, Evelynn, and Tiana
Fruit Notes Volume 83, Number 2, Spring 2018 article reporting fruit-quality characteristics for Rutgers Brigantine nectarine and Evelynn and Tiana peaches in southern New Jersey

locations.name: Rutgers Fruit and Ornamental Research Extension Center, Cream Ridge, New Jersey

categories.name: Rutgers Brigantine Evelynn and Tiana fruit quality observations
categories.description: Fruit Notes reports southern New Jersey fruit-quality observations for Rutgers Brigantine nectarine and Evelynn and Tiana peaches

rows.name: NJN 102
rows.category: Rutgers Brigantine Evelynn and Tiana fruit quality observations
rows.harvest_time: July 15 to August 3 in southern New Jersey
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Brigantine as a yellow-fleshed nectarine with good commercial potential. The article says it produced very attractively finished fruit with good size and firmness, and sweet, acidic, tangy flavor

rows.name: NJ 357
rows.category: Rutgers Brigantine Evelynn and Tiana fruit quality observations
rows.harvest_time: July 20 to August 5 in southern New Jersey
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Evelynn as a new peach with good commercial potential. The article says it produced large fruit with very good firmness and low acid, giving a sweet and delicate flavor

rows.name: NJ 359
rows.category: Rutgers Brigantine Evelynn and Tiana fruit quality observations
rows.harvest_time: August 2 to 28 in southern New Jersey
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Tiana as a new peach with good commercial potential. The article says it yielded consistently firm, large fruit that are sweet and acidic, giving a tangy flavor
